owner_statement: D-P5.5-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P5.5 Investigation And Evidence. The authorized planning scope includes investigation workspace and evidence workspace operator workflows; append-only typed investigation timelines; observation, inference, hypothesis, candidate, proposed-alert, review, correction, retraction, relationship, action, and system-entry presentation; record-time, event-time, sequence, freshness, and durable ordering views; timeline list, detail, pagination, virtualization, filtering, and bounded time navigation; deterministic reconstruction through an exact revision; before-and-after state comparison; correction and retraction propagation; investigation relationship and provenance graphs with authoritative list and table alternatives; immutable evidence-reference list and detail views; evidence identity, source reference, integrity state, verification history, provenance, derivation, custody-event, access, and limitation projections; source-reference-without-copying and media-reference-without-rendering defaults; generated-only retention, hold, deletion, disposition, and purpose-bound export preview workflows that remain explicitly non-operative; disabled case-management bridge views; generated-only PROV-compatible interchange projections without external import or conformance claims; department and role authorization; ETag, idempotency, concurrency, conflict, stale-state, and recovery contracts; loading, empty, partial, stale, degraded, denied, conflict, failure, correction, retraction, and recovery states; low-resource, enhanced-workstation, control-room, GPU-lab, and future-server profiles without changing operator authority; accessibility and keyboard workflows; security, privacy, provenance, integrity, misuse, overclaim, tampering, and evidence-confusion threat analysis; dependency evaluation; generated-only fixtures and validation; producer-gap inventory; owner decision options; and a bounded P5.5 implementation and start plan. Planning must preserve the accepted Phase 4 investigation-timeline and evidence contracts, the accepted Phase 5 Shared Application Foundation, Command Center, GIS Center, Camera and Live Monitoring Workspace, and Intelligence Center contracts. Evidence integrity must never be presented as factual truth, identity confirmation, guilt, legal admissibility, or proof of an event. The UI must not resolve, copy, download, export, print, delete, hold, release, render, or modify source evidence. Corrections and retractions must remain append-only and must not erase historical states. Internet research is limited to official primary technical, security, privacy, accessibility, digital-evidence, records-management, provenance, API, event-contract, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one local checkpoint commit without push are authorized. This does not authorize product or test implementation, source import, dependency installation or lockfile changes, backend routes or migrations, frontend or browser runtime, source-media or evidence copying, resolution, rendering, download, print, export, deletion, modification, hold activation or release, retention-period or legal-policy decisions, real investigations or case systems, providers or network access, credentials or secrets, cameras or media, Government or private data, real identities, models, datasets, artifacts or inference, operational alerts, notifications, dispatch, enforcement or autonomous actions, containers, Kubernetes, deployment, P5.6, or remote Git.
